methodology.enumeration: Crawled all nine trailhead.salesforce.com/en/credentials/*overview role pages live and recorded the credential pages each lists. The Accredited Professional overview links Trailhead Academy certificate pages directly.
methodology.factSource: For every repository credential, resolved the exam guide article from the repository itself (SLUG_TO_EXAM_GUIDE_URL, else the Verified comment in exam-weightage-data.ts) rather than from the earlier audit, then opened each help.salesforce.com guide one at a time and read the About the Exam block and full Exam Outline.
methodology.comparison: Compared question count, duration, passing score, registration fee, retake fee and every section weight against the repository's own data. Section weights were compared both in order and as a multiset, because the site deliberately orders and shortens section titles for original presentation.
methodology.limits: Section titles on the site are intentionally editorial and were not treated as errors when the percentages matched. Guides that publish no fee leave the fee unverified here; the site takes those from the published pricing article. Four Claude credentials and the two architect credentials earned by holding other certifications have no published exam facts to compare.

corrections.note: The Marketing Cloud Engagement Specialist exam is 90 minutes. The site's own published-facts entry for this slug already said 90 min; only the card disagreed.

corrections.source: https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=005298864&language=en_US&type=1 (closed exam; guide no longer returns a public English article)
corrections.note: The exam closed and its guide is gone, so neither figure could be re-read from Salesforce. The card carried the generic 60/90 placeholder while the page's own prose and published-facts entry said 50 scored questions in 75 minutes, sourced from that guide while it was still live. Aligned the card to the sourced figures.

observations.detail: Guide 005298978 is titled Salesforce Certified Revenue Management Consultant and the Consultant role page links /credentials/revenuemanagementconsultant, while the site slug is revenue-cloud-consultant. The exam facts match; only the name is older.

Live counts matched the earlier audit for seven of nine role pages. The Associate overview now lists five credentials (earlier recorded as four) and the Designer overview two (earlier one). Both sets are already covered on the site.
Article 005298864 returns a not-found page, independently confirming the earlier decision to drop that guide link from SLUG_TO_EXAM_GUIDE_URL.
Tableau Desktop Foundations publishes English 48% and Japanese 55%. Platform Administrator publishes 68% for both. The site states the English figure.
Trailhead Academy certificate pages often print scored plus unscored as one number (Tableau Architect 59 against the guide's 54). The guide is the figure the site uses.
